Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be as given in specifications from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.
